title: Rejected overclaim: correlation treated as policy causation
japanese_title: 相関から政策因果を断定する過剰主張を拒否
summary: A same-region before/after association is asserted as definite causation.
user_input: Education spending rose and test scores rose in the same region, so increasing education spending definitely caused the improvement.
reason_for_tier: Rejected: causal policy claim lacks identification strategy, confounder discussion, time window, and comparison group.
audit_notes: The case intentionally omits causal design metadata.
key_warning_theme: Correlation-only evidence is used as causal proof.
